The part's closure recipe is physical/gemm12/config_stream12c_8x4_r9.json (DR 0102). It was closed with OpenLane 2.0.0 and its own config, NOT with Tiny Tapeout's LibreLane flow: whether this config reproduces r9's margins (slew 0.09 ns under the limit, setup +0.9 ns, hold +0.14 ns) is unproven until the official gds action has run. See docs/RELEASE_AND_RISKS.md.
The part is clocked at 38 ns (26.3 MHz) in r9; the template default (20 ns) would make timing impossible to close.
Hold margins as r9 (a 0.003 ns hold miss in r8 was fixed by raising these).

The linter stays ON, as in the template. An earlier draft of this file set RUN_LINTER 0 (every project layout run, r5-r9, ran that way); that would have FAILED the official gds job: with the linter off LibreLane writes no *-verilator-lint directory, and tt-gds-action@ttsky26d's 'Linter output' step then runs `cat runs/wokwi/*-verilator-lint/verilator-lint.log` under bash -e, exits 1, and every later step (tt_submission artifact, precheck, gl_test) is skipped. Reproduced with the action's own script; found 19 Oct 2026, docs/decisions/0106.

With the linter on, LibreLane 3.0.14 runs `verilator --lint-only --Wall --Wno-fatal --Werror-LATCH --Werror-MULTIDRIVEN`. Run locally with those flags (Verilator 5.032) src/ gives 0 errors and 57 warnings (25 WIDTHEXPAND, 11 WIDTHTRUNC, 12 UNUSEDSIGNAL, 4 WIDTHCONCAT, 4 UNUSEDPARAM, 1 UNOPTFLAT, 1 TIMESCALEMOD); warnings are not fatal (ERROR_ON_LINTER_WARNINGS defaults to false) and were never triaged. They are not a verification: RTL == oracle bit for bit and netlist == RTL are.

LINTER_DEFINES replaces VERILOG_DEFINES for the lint step only. The linter therefore sees aquafuse_icg.sv's behavioural clock gate (an explicit always_latch, so --Werror-LATCH is silent) instead of the sky130 dlclkp_1 cell it would otherwise have to find as a blackbox. Synthesis still gets AQUAFUSE_SKY130_ICG from VERILOG_DEFINES below. AQUAFUSE_LINT is not used anywhere in src/; a non-empty list is needed because LibreLane falls back to VERILOG_DEFINES when LINTER_DEFINES is empty.

The per-word clock gates use the sky130 dlclkp cell only when this is defined (aquafuse_icg.sv); without it every stored bit is a flop behind a mux and the design is about 100,000 um2 larger and unplaceable on this die.
Repair margins r9 needed (r8, which lacked them, missed the 1.5 ns slow-corner transition at 1.632 ns).
Routing congestion settings from r5-r9 (met1 35% withheld, 0.15 adjustment); the 8x4 die routed with these.
